title: Payment gateway
goal: Show a gateway selecting provider implementations through an interface.

rubric.must: PaymentProvider is visibly marked as an interface.
CardProvider and WalletProvider each use dashed hollow-triangle realization arrows pointing to PaymentProvider.
Payment has a filled composition diamond to PaymentRequest.
PaymentStatus is visibly an enumeration-like classifier listing PENDING, AUTHORIZED, and DECLINED.
PaymentService has a dashed dependency arrow to PaymentRequest.
